articles.title: Palestinian Christians are disappearing. Warnings are not enough.
articles.author: Dave Reed
articles.content_excerpt: Church leaders, activists, and Palestinian media keep sounding the alarm: Palestinian Christians are leaving the Holy Land. We need an institutional and economic strategy that makes staying a viable choice, not just a moral one.

articles.title: Brazil must not surrender its critical minerals
articles.author: Vijay Prashad
articles.content_excerpt: In Minaçu, in the northern part of the Brazilian state of Goiás, the landscape bears the scars of an earlier mineral rush. For decades, the town depended on the Cana Brava asbestos mine, whose prosperity was inseparable from lethal illnesses and a long history of environmental damage. Now Minaçu has been recruited into another promised future. At the Pela Ema mine, Serra Verde extracts rare-earth elements required for electric motors, wind turbines, advanced electronics, and weapons systems. The mineral has changed, but the danger is that the old structure of dependency will remain intact. Brazil possesses approximately 23% of the world’s known rare-earth reserves, second only to China. articles.title: Israel kills three in airstrike on Jenin
articles.author: Aseel Saleh
articles.content_excerpt: The Israeli Army announced on Friday, August 28 that it launched a drone strike in the northern West Bank city of Jenin, killing three Palestinian resistance fighters. It added that Qais Bitawi, whom it described as a Hamas operative in the dismantled Jenin Brigade, was among the fatalities. The other two slain men were identified as Basel Turkman and Ahmad Yaqoub Turkman, according to local media outlets which also reported that the bodies of the three Palestinians were confiscated by the Israeli forces. The deadly attack marks the first Israeli airstrike in the occupied West Bank in 10 months. articles.title: Canada vs. Trump: Is this a trade war or something bigger?
articles.author: Rania Khalek
articles.content_excerpt: Trump torched trade talks with Canada last week after demanding veto power over Canada’s own infrastructure spending and its ability to make deals with other countries. articles.title: Babies are being held in ICE detention in Texas with Rep. Joaquin Castro
articles.author: Rania Khalek
articles.content_excerpt: “The commodification of child imprisonment” under Donald Trump is making CoreCivic and GEO Group executives even richer, Rep. Joaquin Castro tells Rania Khalek and Zoe Alexandra. The Democrat representing Texas’s 20th Congressional District says babies as young as two months old are being held in ICE detention, and parents are being coerced into helping entrap their own children, all while private prison giants profit off every kid DHS locks up. Castro breaks down what he’s witnessed inside facilities like the Dilley “trailer prison,” and the explosion of 287(g) agreements turning local police departments into DHS henchmen.
